text_block_list.text:
It's afternoon on a Saturday.
I'm on my way 
back to the station after running an
errand.

Oh, Tray-chan. 
Nice coincidence. Yeah!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
I'm about to head to the cinema to see if
there 
are any movies worth watching.
Wanna join me?
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Sounds good! I'm free this afternoon.

text_block_list.text:
I can't help but get excited when I'm at
the cinema. 
I wonder if it's the smell of the butter
and caramel?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Well... How about you choose, Tray-chan? No need to consider my tastes, I'm fine with watching anything. Go on!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
I take a look at the movies that are playing
soon. 
There's one that stands out...

Two completely unrelated words. 
The trailer suggests it's an over-the-top
action movie 
full of explosions...

Haha. I figured you'd choose that one. 
I spotted it as well.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
I like that director. 
They keep making unique movies.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
They keep coming up with interesting challenges
for themselves,
and absolutely demolish every previous
release 
with their new ones. I love it!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you made your choice. 
Let's grab some tickets!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Hm hmm. About the seats...
What do you prefer? 
Smack-dab in the middle or more on the
side?
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: I like to sit in the center if pos...

text_block_list.text:
Agreed.
Sitting in the middle gives the best
experience, 
even if it can be a little crowded.
And to be honest, 
I already bought the tickets while you were
thinking.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha,
that's right!
The cinema atmosphere really 
makes you want to buy everything.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
There's still time until it starts.
How about 
we explore every nook and cranny of this
place?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Hey, let me guess if you want to buy popcorn
or not. 
'Kay?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. My prediction: You'll buy.
The movie has many explosions,
which means there'll be plenty of
opportunities 
to munch on some popcorn.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Heck yeah, my info was right! 
That's +500 Tray-chan points for me!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Don't you think waiting for the movie to
start is the best 
part of going to the cinema?
It's exciting to wonder 
what the movie might be like.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
And so, after spending some time together,
it was about 
time for the movie to begin.
I follow the visibly excited 
Transcend into the hall.

That movie exceeded my expectations!
I couldn't 
help myself but speak my thoughts about
this 
nonstop action masterpiece!

Oh, did the movie check all the boxes for
you?
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: You bet! To start, the composition—
You bet! To start, the composition—

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I get you.
That director is very good at action
movies. 
And? Any other points of interest?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
That sure was a surprise right at the
end. 
And? Keep that trademark Tray-chan review
going!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
With that thought in the back of my head,
a sense of unease washed over me.
Did I incorrectly assume she felt the
same about the movie as me?
I'm honestly a bit startled...

Oh, I'm out of coffee. 
Want another one as well?
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Did you... Not like the movie?

text_block_list.text: Huh?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Well... Um... 
Aha, really?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Gosh. 
You saw through me, huh?
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Alright then,
I'll tell you what I thought of it.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
There wasn't the usual challenge in this
one.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
This director has always posed a special
challenge for themselves with every movie.
Like not having the main 
character speak,
or filming the entire thing on a phone.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
For this one,
they just took all the things that worked 
previously and crammed them together. 
It was a big turn-off for me.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Now it finally makes sense to me. 
She...

Yeah... That's basically it.
But I did like that one scene. 
That big gunpowder explosion of the
skyscraper!
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Surely that got you excited, right?
Surely that got you excited, right?

text_block_list.text: Sure, it got me excited alright! But like, not excited excited, if you get what I mean.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
Like,
it was funny. I laughed a ton! But like, 
I wanted to be excited by whatever
challenge 
the director gave themselves...
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
That was scary as heck!
But not exciting... 
Hey, are you bringing that up on purpose?!
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
The thing about the photography... Oh,
has the clock glitched 
out or is it really this late already?
I've got so much more 
to talk about!
text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: You were so into it, too!

text_block_list.text:
Haha.
Let's call it a wrap and continue another time,
'kay? 
Time to say goodbye for now.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: (...I thought I saw through them.)
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text:
(I thought it'd be better if I played along.
Hiding my 
true feelings. Surely they wouldn't notice.
But...)
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: "Did you... Not like the movie?"

(I miscalculated... 
There's still a lot more to learn about
them.)
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: ... Hehe.
text_block_list.name: Transcend

text_block_list.text: Oh man... That got me excited.
text_block_list.name: Transcend
